scope: Allocation probes exclude rasterization/simulation; allocation sampling varies with V8 optimization and warmup.
Traversal validates readiness and actual movement; desktop checks overlapped the browser suite and are not a timing baseline.
Phone: short plugged-in run, native touch/viewport, no CPU emulation. Cold-entry gaps remain separate work.
Recording backend is a contract proof, not a GPU implementation or performance forecast.

grassFreshControl.method: Read-only Vite pre-load of git-show source, same probe/browser; no checkout mutation.
grassFreshControl.interpretation: Grass code, direct dependencies and probe are byte-identical to pre-series. Sampled totals vary 13.49–20.03 MB across current runs; counters and hashes are identical. Do not interpret this as a grass speedup/regression.
